notes: v2.122 (2026-11-21, morning run): 121st tower 'Toy Box' (toys peeking over a rim on a wide box body on two feet — a toy-box silhouette to demolish, 33 blocks, 7 clusters sizes 2/2/3/5/7/7/7, all 4 colours, no singletons, 0 canonical duplicates) + 118th co-play prompt (put big soft toys in one by one saying 'in… in!', tip the box over and take them all out saying 'out… out!', look inside saying 'all gone… empty!', fill it up again saying 'full… full!'). Containing-schema research: filling and emptying containers is a toddler schema — it teaches space, size, and volume (which things fit, which don't), builds fine-motor grasping and hand-eye coordination, and the in/out + full/empty words land at the moment the toys go in or come out; tipping is the experiment, not destruction, so the prompt gives it a safe form (big soft toys, grown-up tips a heavy box).
